page_summary:
The Exegesis of Philip K. Dick is the canonical works record for PKD's primary text. It gathers 2 archive manifestations under one bibliographic heading so edition history, duplication, adaptation, or later republication can be read together. The manifestations span 2 archive PDFs. Visible examples include The Exegesis of Philip K. Dick (2011), The Exegesis of Philip K. Dick (2011). The longest manifestation in the set runs 1137 pages.
